items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: Mr. F, you see me by the set of drums, you say, I can't be that old man.

ctx.x: A lot of the banjo players have the mute, you know, the mute on the side. Some of them have somebody just could push it down his leg.

Yeah, use it on their knee, you know. That's his knee some of them. Yeah, some of them have that knee action on us, you know. And I like any instrument. I mean, I like a loud drum on a parade in spots. Sometimes you're playing in funerals, a lot of spots you have piano, you've got to get very soft. But I never did like no loud drum, but I like to be very active behind my drum. And now that is. Mr. F, you see me by the set of drums, you say, I can't be that old man. I don't double stage still, I sit on them…
